body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes critical console test infrastructure issues and updates roadmap documentation to reflect the actual completion status of all development phases. The changes address 12 failing test files by resolving missing Vite aliases and a hard dependency on an uninitialized git submodule, bringing the total passing tests from 21 to 34 files (273 tests).

**Changes:**
- Fixed missing Vite resolve aliases for `@object-ui/collaboration` and `@object-ui/i18n` packages
- Replaced static imports with dynamic `@vite-ignore` imports in hotcrm-bridge.js to gracefully handle missing git submodule
- Fixed `formatPercent` test bug by adding the missing precision parameter
- Added comprehensive ExpressionVisibility tests (12 new tests)
- Updated CONSOLE_ROADMAP.md and NEXT_STEPS.md to document completion of Phases 1-9 and 11-18

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| vitest.config.mts | Added missing `@object-ui/collaboration` alias to fix test import resolution |
| apps/console/vite.config.ts | Added missing `@object-ui/collaboration` and `@object-ui/i18n` aliases for console app |
| examples/hotcrm-bridge.js | Replaced static imports with `@vite-ignore` dynamic imports to gracefully handle missing hotcrm git submodule, preventing hard failures in CI/fresh clones |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/BrowserSimulation.test.tsx | Fixed formatPercent test by adding precision parameter (test expected 2 decimal places but function defaults to 0) |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/ExpressionVisibility.test.tsx | New test file with 12 tests covering evaluateVisibility function, ExpressionProvider context propagation, and navigation filtering |
| apps/console/NEXT_STEPS.md | Updated to show all Phases 11-18 as complete with per-task status tables |
| apps/console/CONSOLE_ROADMAP.md | Updated to reflect completion of Phases 1-9, showing current state v0.5.2 with all features implemented |
</details>
